metadata.conformance_disclaimer: Adapted to local KG JSON import schema using concepts from references; no formal SNOMED CT, FHIR, WHO ICD, OBO or SHACL compliance claimed
change_log: Consolidated PrimaryTuberculosis/PleuralTuberculosis/LymphNodeTuberculosis into DiseaseSubtype; 4 corpus occurrences; remapped two exact-name TB entity IDs to pre-existing DiseaseSubtype IDs
Allowed DiseaseSubtype in INCREASES_RISK_OF range to preserve six sourced KG relationships
Removed six unused, unconstrained equipment leaf types from KG label space; kept meaningful examples in metadata
Retained NegativePressureRoom as type due 1 corpus occurrence and explicit domain/range semantics
Added explicit role for ClinicalCondition as reviewed fallback only (105 legacy occurrences preserved)
Added causal, indication, therapy and recommendation relation semantics without blind triple rewriting
Added strict structured epidemiological attribute schema; no invented instance/data
Kept PREVENTED_BY and DIFFERENTIAL_DIAGNOSIS domain expansions rejected until source-level reviews

compatibility.validated_corpus_format: source/target; arrays; canonical global relation ids

corpus_coverage.basis: 71 Markdown source docs and 93 migrated KG JSON units

semantic_governance.reference_alignment_mode: principles and analogies, not exact-equivalence claims or licensed SNOMED terminology reuse

ClinicalCondition.legacy_corpus: keep 105 historical occurrence records for evidence-grounded review; no guessed retagging

equipment_type_vs_concept.retain_type_NegativePressureRoom: yes; actually used in 1 KG record and constrained by HAS_AIR_PRESSURE/REQUIRES_VENTILATION

CAUSES.for_new_ingestion: assert only if evidence supports causal claim, not merely risk/predictive association

HAS_CAUSE.new_ingestion: discouraged; candidate reverse into CAUSES only after explicit evidence/directness check

CAUSED_BY_CONDITION.preferred_for: specific condition-to-condition causation rather than mere risk association

TREATS.inverse_of_TREATED_BY: partial, only where both endpoint types and semantics truly align

TREATED_BY.means: general medical knowledge about treatment, NOT evidence of treatment administered to a patient

HAS_INDICATION.new_ingestion: prefer INDICATED_FOR for a directly named disease/population, HAS_INDICATION for explicit Indication concept

RECOMMENDS_TREATMENT.means: protocol/guideline recommendation only, not evidence of patient treatment

PREVENTED_BY.ClinicalCondition_domain_expansion: REJECTED pending 9 item evidence review; do not mask typing errors

DIFFERENTIAL_DIAGNOSIS.ClinicalCondition_domain_expansion: REJECTED pending 19 item evidence review; only a diagnostic concept may be a target, never full-text criterion sentence

HAS_FINDING.direct_overexpansion: REJECTED pending 125 ClinicalCondition + 69 DiseaseSubtype deferred source reviews

data_layers.knowledge_graph: general reference medical facts only; not actual patient history
data_layers.patient_graph: confirmed patient-specific assertions in a separate store/context
data_layers.epidemiology: requires population, period, geography and measure unit before promoting to graph

S1.title: SNOMED CT — Clinical finding and disorder
S1.supports: Disease/disorder khác clinical finding; phân biệt observable entity và quan sát.

S2.title: SNOMED CT — Clinical finding defining attributes
S2.supports: Due-to dành cho quan hệ nhân quả trực tiếp; associated-with cho liên quan/yếu tố nguy cơ.

S3.title: FHIR R5 — Condition
S3.supports: Condition là đối tượng lâm sàng và có verification status, category, stage và evidence riêng.

S4.title: FHIR R5 — MedicationRequest
S4.supports: Intent và reason/indication của yêu cầu điều trị khác event đã diễn ra.

S5.title: FHIR R5 — PlanDefinition
S5.supports: Recommendation/guideline/action definition không phải hành động đã diễn ra.

S6.title: FHIR R5 — ActivityDefinition
S6.supports: Hoạt động định nghĩa khác yêu cầu thực hiện/đã thực hiện.

S7.title: WHO — Tuberculosis definitions
S7.supports: Lao ngoài phổi gồm lao màng phổi, hạch và các cơ quan ngoài phổi.

S8.title: FHIR R5 — DeviceDefinition
S8.supports: Phân biệt loại/mẫu thiết bị và thể hiện một thiết bị cụ thể.

S9.title: WHO GHO — TB incidence per 100,000
S9.supports: Incidence phụ thuộc time period, quần thể, đơn vị (100.000 người/năm).

S10.title: OBO Foundry — Principle 7 Relations
S10.supports: Tái sử dụng quan hệ, tránh đồng nghĩa và thận trọng domain/range.

S11.title: OBO RO — Causal relations
S11.supports: Causal influence, direction và temporality là semantics khác nhau.

S12.title: W3C — SKOS reference
S12.supports: Exact mapping khác close mapping và OWL class equivalence.

S13.title: W3C — SHACL recommendation
S13.supports: Validation shapes có thể kiểm soát ràng buộc graph và báo lỗi minh bạch.

entity_hierarchy_policy.type_vs_instance: Types are reusable semantic categories in KG JSON; specific named diseases and device kinds are concept instances unless evidence requires an actual schema class.
